key_claims: The United Nations reports that by 2050, the number of people age 85 and older is set to triple.
A longer life span is not the same as a longer health span.
Salk Institute scientists are conducting foundational research on cellular mechanisms driving age-related dysfunction.
limitations: The source does not specify the enzyme or the research details.
The source does not provide evidence for the claims about aging or health span.
The source does not mention any specific study or findings.
what_not_to_say: Do not claim that the enzyme removes zombie cells from tissues.
Do not claim that Salk Institute has found a way to extend health span.
Do not claim that the research is conclusive or has been tested in humans.
